Kynikos Associates LP Has Lifted Holding in Western Digital (WDC) as Share Price Rose; Amazon.Com (AMZN) Shareholder Pcj Investment Counsel LTD Has Lifted Position by $455,910
May 10, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Jim Chanos increased its stake in Western Digital Corp (WDC) by 16.64% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kynikos Associates Lp bought 7,126 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.25% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Jim Chanos held 49,950 shares of the electronic components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.97 million, up from 42,824 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kynikos Associates Lp who had been investing in Western Digital Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $23.55B market cap company. The stock increased 0.31% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $78.69. About 1.86M shares traded. Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) has risen 17.32% since May 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 5.77% the S&P500.
Pcj Investment Counsel Ltd increased its stake in Amazon.Com Inc (AMZN) by 46.43% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 1,230 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.44M, up from 840 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pcj Investment Counsel Ltd who had been investing in Amazon.Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $779.28B market cap company.
